summary: This note is a short biography of Ernie Watts, an English footballer born in 1872 in Woolhampton, Berkshire. It traces his career from early days at Reading through Notts County (17 Football League appearances), a second Reading spell, West Ham United (captain in the club's final season at the Memorial Grounds), New Brompton from 1904, and later Grays Athletic, Clapton Orient and two more Reading spells.
one_line: English footballer born in Woolhampton in 1872 whose career spanned Reading, Notts County, West Ham United, New Brompton and Clapton Orient.
key_facts: Ernie Watts was born in Woolhampton in Berkshire.
Ernie Watts's earliest known club was Reading.
Ernie Watts made 17 appearances in The Football League for Notts County.

Ernie Watts was captain of West Ham United for the club's final season at the Memorial Grounds.
Ernie Watts joined New Brompton in 1904.
Ernie Watts was a regular starter for New Brompton during the 1904–05 season.
Ernie Watts's later clubs included Grays Athletic.
Ernie Watts's later clubs included Clapton Orient.
Ernie Watts had two more spells with Reading after his later clubs.
